scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible: the verifier cannot re-run the full DFT calculation; only the final reported moments are available. Paper numbers quoted directly.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported ferromagnetic magnetic moments for Co1, Co2, and O in Ca3Co2O6
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Section 3.2 of 'Extended moment formation and magnetic ordering in the trigonal chain compound Ca3Co2O6' (Eyert et al., 2004), stating moments of 0.35 μB (Co1), 2.73 μB (Co2), and 0.14 μB (O).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual computationally obtained values reported by the paper, needed for result-level comparison.

outputs.description: Site-projected magnetic moments for Co1, Co2, and oxygen from a spin-polarized DFT calculation on ferromagnetic Ca3Co2O6.

output_contract.notes: The oxygen moment may be averaged over all oxygen sites. Tolerances for scoring are defined in the hidden grading spec and are not disclosed here.
